stage_b_policy.release_gate: Release only after Stage A candidate and interface choices are committed, the family split is independently checked, and the confirmation protocol is frozen.

integrity.task_id_rule: ORBIT-{A|B}-S{01..10}-{001..012}; IDs are assigned only after the task contract and environment fixture are materialized.
integrity.deduplication_policy: Check exact normalized prompts, semantic task structure, fixture lineage, tool-schema family, dependency graph, and family fingerprints before panel freeze; prompt paraphrases do not establish independence.
freeze_requirements: All 240 task records exist and reconcile to 12 per stage per stratum.
Stage A and Stage B family and independence-group identifiers are disjoint.
Every task has a pinned environment or authoritative snapshot and SHA-256 state fingerprint.
Every task has at least one mechanically executable or independently reviewable postcondition.
Every grader has a version, tested assertions, and a non-LLM-only evidence path.
Stage B prompts and fixtures are access-restricted before Stage A model/interface selection.
Model adapters, tool manifests, permissions, seeds, budgets, and decode policies are frozen before any comparative run.

existing_development_pilot.purpose: Integration and harness smoke tests only; not members of Stage A or Stage B and not model-capability evidence.

notes: Ten initial Stage A plugin-native task instances have been authored, one per stratum. This is 10 of 120 Stage A target tasks; no Stage B tasks are materialized.

Stage A task records are ready for model validation, not validated capability results. Model execution remains disabled in every record.
